title: [RESOLVED] Age Verification Not Completing Successfully
body:
Update as of February 19, 2026 (3:50PM PST): This outage is now resolved.

We were investigating reports that users were being asked to perform age verification again and that some verifications were not completing successfully.

This was unintentional behavior and our team has deployed a fix for this issue. 

What if I'm Still Running into Issues?

Please refresh and restart your Discord application. 

If the full restart does not work, please contact our team following the steps in this article: How to Submit a Support Ticket to Discord
